passive2Subtitle: Your first Passive is your main defense. Pick a second Passive from a different category.

guidedDeliveryOptions.label: Melee
guidedDeliveryOptions.explanation: You fight in close combat with a weapon, claws, fists, or another close-range attack.

guidedDeliveryOptions.label: Ranged
guidedDeliveryOptions.explanation: You fight at distance. If your axe, blade, bow, spell-shot, or artifact attack is meant to hit enemies far away, choose Ranged.

passive1Variants.label: Armor
passive1Variants.description: Simple, reliable Armor. You always gain flat Armor. Best default choice for most Armor characters.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain permanent Armor.

passive1Variants.label: Armor + Temporary HP
passive1Variants.description: Less pure Armor, but adds a frontloaded buffer. Good if you want to survive the opening of combat better.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain Armor plus Temporary HP.

passive1Variants.label: Armor (Moved 0 m Last Turn)
passive1Variants.description: Stronger Armor when you hold your ground. Better for players who want tactical play instead of a pure always-on bonus.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain Armor only while the listed condition is true.

passive1Variants.label: Armor (Adjacent to 2+ Enemies)
passive1Variants.description: Armor that spikes when enemies crowd you. Rewards staying in the thick of melee.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain Armor only while the listed condition is true.

passive1Variants.label: Armor / Temporary HP (Conditional)
passive1Variants.description: Armor and Temporary HP when allies are nearby. Tactical, team-aware defense.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain Armor plus Temporary HP only while the listed condition is true.

passive1Variants.label: Armor / Healing (Conditional)
passive1Variants.description: Armor and healing when you stand still. Rewards holding a position.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain Armor and healing only while the listed condition is true.

passive1Variants.label: Armor / Health (Conditional)
passive1Variants.description: Armor and extra health when allies are nearby. A durable anchor for the party.
passive1Variants.mechanicsPreview: Gain Armor and health only while the listed condition is true.

armor.defensiveActiveBuffChoiceBody: Your Buff gives you more Armor.

defaultActiveBuffPreview.name: Armor
defaultActiveBuffPreview.fluff: You reinforce your body, armor, stance, magic, skin, or guard with a temporary defensive layer.

buffs.label: Turn-start healing
buffs.explanation: Sustain yourself or allies with steady healing while the buff lasts.
buffs.rankPreview: At the start of your turn, heal 32 HP.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Temporary HP buffer
buffs.explanation: Frontload protection for the opening of a fight.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain 32 Temporary HP.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Spell Resistance
buffs.explanation: Reject hostile spell structure for the duration.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain +8 Spell Resistance.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Cleanse Maintenance
buffs.explanation: Steadily reduce one negative ongoing effect on you each turn.
buffs.rankPreview: At the start of your turn, reduce one eligible negative ongoing creature effect affecting you by 4.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Armor Aura
buffs.explanation: Share Armor with nearby allies.
buffs.rankPreview: You and allies within 8 m gain +12 Armor.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Healing Aura
buffs.explanation: Support allies with shared healing pressure.
buffs.rankPreview: At the end of each of your turns, allies within 2 m heal 3d8 HP.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Immovable + Temporary HP
buffs.explanation: Anchor yourself and allies with layered protection.
buffs.rankPreview: For 2 Rounds you become Immovable and gain 40 Temporary HP. While Immovable you ignore Push, Pull, Prone, forced movement, and grapple-based forced moves.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Armor + Temporary HP
buffs.explanation: Layer Armor and a protective buffer.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain +5 Armor and 20 Temporary HP.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Evade + Temporary HP
buffs.explanation: Slip hits and buffer what gets through.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain +2 Evade. At the start of each of your turns, if you have less than 22 Temporary HP, restore it up to 22 Temporary HP.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Temporary HP + Healing
buffs.explanation: Buffer plus sustain for longer fights.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain 16 Temporary HP. Recover 16 HP at the start of each of your turns.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Armor + Evade
buffs.explanation: Hybrid defensive profile for unpredictable threats.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain +9 Armor and +4 Evade.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

buffs.label: Growth Form
buffs.explanation: Utility form shift with defensive reach and presence.
buffs.rankPreview: Gain +4d8 Damage and +8 Armor. Large Form (3 hexes, +2 m Reach). Drawback: -4 Evade, -4 Initiative.
buffs.durationNote: Lasts for your Mastery Rank in rounds. Costs your Attack action to activate.

passives.label: Evade
passives.hint: Permanent Evade.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Gain +4 Evade.

passives.label: Evade (Exactly 1 Adjacent Enemy)
passives.hint: Evade while exactly one enemy is adjacent.
passives.mechanicsPreview: While exactly one enemy is adjacent to you, gain +5 Evade.

passives.label: Evade (Moved 8+ m This Turn)
passives.hint: Evade after you move at least 8 m on your turn.
passives.mechanicsPreview: If you moved at least 8 m on your turn, gain +5 Evade until the start of your next turn.

passives.label: Evade + Healing
passives.hint: Permanent Evade plus start-of-turn Healing.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Gain +2 Evade. At the start of your turn, heal 5 HP.

passives.label: Evade + Temporary HP
passives.hint: Permanent Evade plus Temporary HP at combat start.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Gain +2 Evade. At the start of combat, gain 20 Temporary HP.

passives.label: Parry
passives.hint: Spend a Parry pool to strip Attack Dice before they roll.
passives.mechanicsPreview: While in Parry (no Attack Action), Maximum Parry Pool 20 (Parry Attribute Might or Agility, capped at 5 × Level). Spend 1:1 to remove Attack Dice before the roll; 0 dice = Fully Parried.

passives.label: Damage Reduction
passives.hint: Percentage reduction on incoming damage.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Gain 10% Damage Reduction.

passives.label: Damage Negation
passives.hint: Spend a combat reserve of Damage Dice before damage is rolled.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Combat reserve 16 Damage Dice. Spend before the damage roll; at most half the pool (floor). No mid-combat refresh.

passives.label: Phasing
passives.hint: Ignore a limited number of hits each combat.
passives.mechanicsPreview: At the start of combat, gain 1 Phasing charge. Each charge lets you ignore one hit against you.

passives.label: Invisibility
passives.hint: Blocks Normal Combat Awareness and, at higher ranks, chosen Special Senses.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Gain +4 Invisibility Bonus. Blocks Normal Combat Awareness and 1 chosen Special Combat Sense.

passives.label: Health + Temporary HP
passives.hint: Extra Health Bars plus Temporary HP at combat start.
passives.mechanicsPreview: Gain +1 Wounded Health Bar. At the start of combat, gain 20 Temporary HP.

passives.hint: Temporary HP at the start of combat, before real Health.
passives.mechanicsPreview: At the start of combat, gain 40 Temporary HP.

passives.label: Healing (Moved 0 m Last Turn)
passives.hint: Start-of-turn Healing if you moved 0 m on your last turn.
passives.mechanicsPreview: At the start of your turn, if you moved 0 m on your last turn, heal 20 HP.
